explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/964: 'Is the sequence τ(n+1)/τ(n) everywhere dense in (0,∞)?' (proved by Eberhard). The Lean statement Set.Ioi 0 ⊆ closure (tauRatio '' Set.Ici 1), with tauRatio n = σ₀(n+1)/σ₀(n) in ℝ, says every positive real is a limit of values of the sequence over n ≥ 1, which is exactly density in (0,∞) (the sequence values are themselves positive). Excluding n = 0 avoids the junk value. Faithful.
